BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restructuring ferry districts and the propertytax levied by such districts for certain countywide transit projects.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act shall be known and cited as therestructuring ferry districts and the property tax levied by suchdistricts act of 2009.
